title: Catalog tape contents
statement: Let $f$ be a tape-content function from integer positions to optional symbols, let $a$ be an integer, let $w$ be a finite word, and let $q$ be an integer position. Define the tape content at $q$ by the buffer representation of $w$ at offset $q-a$ when $a\le q<a+|w|$, and by $f(q)$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A fallback tape-content function $f$ is given

caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the exact convention for the buffer representation.
